Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking time last week. Attached is an initial renewal package that reflects the usage trend we saw in Q3–Q4 and the uplift path we discussed. Key points: 

- Current monthly hosted commit: 1.2M tokens (monthly)
- Proposed commit for renewal: 2.1M tokens (1.75x uplift)
- New tiering: introduction of a mid-tier rate band between 1.2M and 3M to reduce per-token unit cost after the uplift
- Scoped rate-limit change: provisional per-route limit increase (2x) for the first 30 days to accommodate ingestion spikes, with monitoring and rollback criteria

Attachments: MercuryShop_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf, 98 KB), usage_report_Oct2026.csv (csv, 64 KB)

Asks: 
1) Can you confirm procurement contact and preferred PO timing?
2) Are there any internal approval windows we should be aware of (legal/finance)?
3) Would you like us to stagger the uplift (50% first month, remainder on month 2)?

If helpful I can propose a one-month credit to smooth the transition while you ramp up ingestion.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Hi Elena / Soojin —

Quick technical notes on the per-route rate increase: 
- We apply QoS-backed per-route limits at the account level; for hosted API this is configured per-API-key.
- For the 30-day provisional window we can double the per-route cap for the keys you designate; keys will be tagged as "escalator_provision" in our routing layer.
- Monitoring: we'll stream token-level latency and throttle events to a shared dashboard and alert if error rate >1% or lat p95 > 600ms for three consecutive 5-min windows.

Operational recommendations: 
- Stagger rollout: enable a single ingestion key for a week, validate KPIs, then enable others.
- Use prefix KV caching for repeated prompts (saves ~18% token cost observed on your Oct report).

Attachment: ops_runbook_rate_limits.md (md, 12 KB) — contains the step-by-step toggle and rollback commands.

Happy to set a 30-minute ops call with your SREs before the Black Friday window.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
